text:
Your visa will probably be extended automatically if a war resumes.

In my case, during the last war the appointment got cancelled and my visa (and intervisa) got extended automatically for 3 months. Bituach also got the automatic extension so I didn't have to do anything extra. We received SMS notifying us for both cases (cancellation and extension). Once the offices opened again we asked to reschedule the appointment for A5 renewal.
